tenant_identity.resolution_point: ProjectProvisioningService before check, plan, apply, status, verify, or resume

resources.name: project provisioning run
resources.residue_policy: immutable execution history and Receipt are retained for audit

data.migration: project-provisioning.v1 schema with forward-only resumable steps
data.rollback: completed facts are retained; resume continues forward

boundary_edges: authenticated organization provisions one explicit project code

clauses.statement: check is read-only and rejects project code collisions before planning.
clauses.rationale: A project identity must not be silently merged or renamed.

story_refs.text_snippet: checkは書き込みを行わず、project codeの衝突を返す

test_refs.case: checkは書き込みを行わない
check APIはwrites_performed 0とauthority/collision detailsを保持する
check CLIはURLへManifestを送りwrites_performed 0とauthority/collision detailsを表示する

test_pattern.must_cover: checkは書き込みを行わない
check APIはwrites_performed 0とauthority/collision detailsを保持する
check CLIはURLへManifestを送りwrites_performed 0とauthority/collision detailsを表示する

clauses.statement: apply persists planned, applying, active, partial_failed, and manual_intervention_required states and resume skips completed steps.
clauses.rationale: Provisioning spans multiple durable systems and must be forward-resumable.

story_refs.text_snippet: planはManifest fingerprint、step、Human Gate、rollback boundaryを永続化する
applyはplannedからapplyingを経てactiveまたはpartial_failedへ遷移する
resumeはcompleted stepを保持し、未完了stepから再開する

test_refs.case: partial_failedから完了stepを保持してresumeする
plan APIはURLのManifestとIdempotency-Keyをservice結果へ保持する
plan CLIはURLへManifestとIdempotency-Keyを送り、plan detailsを表示する

test_pattern.must_cover: partial_failedから完了stepを保持してresumeする
plan APIはURLのManifestとIdempotency-Keyをservice結果へ保持する
plan CLIはURLへManifestとIdempotency-Keyを送り、plan detailsを表示する

clauses.statement: Project Provisioning excludes local_path, delegates Graph writes to Graph Maintenance and auth changes to AuthGrantService, and does not start Connected-world Onboarding; Workspace Setup remains separate.
clauses.rationale: Canonical organization facts, personal workspace paths, repository creation, and content onboarding have different authorities and lifecycles.

story_refs.text_snippet: local_pathはManifestで拒否し、Workspace Setupと分離する
Workspace SetupとConnected-world Onboardingは別Capabilityとして境界を保つ

test_refs.case: local_pathと未知フィールドをfail-closedで拒否する
Project Provisioningの実行経路はConnected-world Onboardingを起動しない

test_pattern.must_cover: local_pathと未知フィールドをfail-closedで拒否する
Project Provisioningの実行経路はConnected-world Onboardingを起動しない

clauses.statement: Graph registration uses the existing Graph Maintenance snapshot, plan, apply, receipt, and validate lifecycle; local contract tests use the Graph writer boundary without claiming a production write.
clauses.rationale: Project Provisioning must not become a second Graph writer authority.

test_refs.case: Graphの正式ライフサイクル順とReceiptをstepへ保存する

test_pattern.must_cover: Graphの正式ライフサイクル順とReceiptをstepへ保存する

clauses.statement: Auth grant mutation goes through AuthGrantService and only set-adds the explicit project code to an active organization-scoped grant.
clauses.rationale: Provisioning must preserve existing grants and tenant boundaries.

story_refs.text_snippet: Auth Grantは専用サービスを通し、既存の有効なGrantへ明示されたproject codeだけを追加する

test_refs.case: organization and role matched grantだけをset-addし、JWT refreshを要求する

test_pattern.must_cover: organization and role matched grantだけをset-addし、JWT refreshを要求する

clauses.statement: Repository Bootstrap is a dedicated adapter; its repository creation and public-visibility contract requires Human Gate approval and readback, while local tests use a fake and production GitHub writes are out of scope.
clauses.rationale: Externally visible and irreversible repository actions need an explicit authority boundary.

story_refs.text_snippet: Repository Bootstrapは専用adapterに分離し、create・public化はHuman Gateとreadbackを必須にする

test_refs.case: create後にrepositoryをreadbackする

test_pattern.must_cover: create後にrepositoryをreadbackする

clauses.statement: Every Plan requires a dedicated Bearer-authenticated manifest_plan_approval bound to the exact Plan scope and Manifest fingerprint; broader operations add gates and apply cannot self-assert approval.
clauses.rationale: Approval must be attributable, immutable, and independent of the mutation request.

story_refs.text_snippet: Human GateはBearer認証済み人物の専用approve操作でManifest fingerprintへ束縛する
link_existingを含む全PlanでManifestとPlan全体のHuman Gate承認前に書き込みを開始しない

test_refs.case: Human GateはBearer認証とPlan完全一致scopeを要求する
link_existingでもManifestとPlanの承認前は一切書き込まない

test_pattern.must_cover: Human GateはBearer認証とPlan完全一致scopeを要求する
link_existingでもManifestとPlanの承認前は一切書き込まない

clauses.statement: The run becomes active only after fresh readback of Registry, Graph validation, every Auth Grant, Repository, and the organization-scoped runtime catalog.
clauses.rationale: A receipt or successful write response is not proof that the canonical systems converged.

story_refs.text_snippet: active遷移前にRegistry・Graph・全Auth Grant・Repositoryを実読戻しする

test_refs.case: 実読戻しが欠ける場合はactiveへ遷移しない
runtime catalogの読戻しが欠ける場合はactiveへ遷移しない

test_pattern.must_cover: 実読戻しが欠ける場合はactiveへ遷移しない
runtime catalogの読戻しが欠ける場合はactiveへ遷移しない

clauses.statement: Project Registry is merged into the organization-scoped runtime Project Catalog for CLI/API/MCP while preserving legacy aliases and repository metadata; loaded, confirmed empty, and unavailable/error states remain distinct.
clauses.rationale: A registered project must become usable by access policy without leaking another organization's catalog.

story_refs.text_snippet: Project Registryを実行時Project Catalogへ接続し、登録後のアクセス判定へ反映する

test_refs.case: catalog readをorganization contextで分離する
/api/brainbaseは認証済みreq.accessのorganizationでcatalogを読みsourceを保持する
registerApiRoutesは/api/brainbase rootへCatalog認証を配線しorganization contextを渡す
TSK-WEBRET-003 AC-2: token and configured scopes are intersected and audit evidence is returned
TSK-WEBRET-003 AC-3: a confirmed empty catalog remains ok instead of unavailable
TSK-WEBRET-003 AC-4: transport failure is unavailable and never flattened to an empty catalog

test_pattern.must_cover: catalog readをorganization contextで分離する
/api/brainbaseは認証済みreq.accessのorganizationでcatalogを読みsourceを保持する
registerApiRoutesは/api/brainbase rootへCatalog認証を配線しorganization contextを渡す
token and configured scopes are intersected, confirmed empty remains ok, and transport failure is unavailable

clauses.statement: Project grants authorize only an exact project ID, explicit alias, or GitHub repository name and never expand by prefix similarity.
clauses.rationale: A short grant must not authorize a different project whose code merely starts with the same text.

story_refs.text_snippet: Project Grantはproject ID・明示alias・GitHub repository名の完全一致だけで判定する

test_refs.case: 短いproject grantをprefixが一致する別projectへ拡張しない

test_pattern.must_cover: 短いproject grantをprefixが一致する別projectへ拡張しない

clauses.statement: session.create and the Session Launch Picker are retired; Codex app/CLI owns task and worktree creation and ownership, while Workspace Setup remains separate from Project Provisioning.
clauses.rationale: The retired selector is not a supported catalog or provisioning surface, and personal workspace paths must not become organization facts.

clauses.statement: Graph writer and GitHub writer assertions use test fakes or adapter doubles; production Graph/GitHub writes and production E2E are out of scope and unverified.
clauses.rationale: Local contract and PostgreSQL integration evidence cannot establish that production external writes have completed.

clauses.statement: Health and config integrity check Project Registry schema availability through the runtime catalog adapter instead of relying only on legacy configuration.
clauses.rationale: A readable legacy config does not prove the canonical Project Registry is ready.

story_refs.text_snippet: healthとintegrityはRegistry schemaの利用可能性を確認する

test_refs.case: organizationなしのreadinessはRegistry schemaの実在を確認する
/api/config/integrityはlegacy parserではなくRegistry-aware catalogを確認する
registerApiRoutesはRegistry-aware runtime catalogを/api/healthへ配線する

test_pattern.must_cover: organizationなしのreadinessはRegistry schemaの実在を確認する
/api/config/integrityはlegacy parserではなくRegistry-aware catalogを確認する
registerApiRoutesはRegistry-aware runtime catalogを/api/healthへ配線する
